comparison.objective: Lower a loaded steel hotel pan level into a steam-table well and release it; candidate breaks and collects HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support and attitude control of a heavy, off-balance pan during close-clearance insertion versus narrow-tool stabilization and impact control.
comparison.success_condition: Pan fully seated, level, contents retained, and hands released without collision or spill; no fracture requirement.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated load placement and spill avoidance, not controlled fracture of a small sacrificial feature.
